### Mercantile Bank Corporation Declares Regular Cash Dividend


October 20, 2026


*Board of Directors declares $0.40 regular quarterly cash dividend on common stock,* *resulting in a current annual yield of approximately 2.7 percent*


GRAND RAPIDS, Mich.


, Oct. 20, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) ("Mercantile") announced today that on October 15, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per common share, payable on December 16, 2026, to holders of record as of December 4, 2026. The $0.40 cash dividend represents an increase of 5.3 percent from the cash dividend paid during the fourth quarter of 2025.


"We are pleased that our financial performance metrics remained robust during the third quarter of 2026, which permitted us to continue our cash dividend program and once more provide shareholders with meaningful cash returns on their investments," said Ray Reitsma, President and Chief Executive Officer of Mercantile. Although macro-economic and geopolitical conditions remain uncertain, we believe our strong balance sheet and ongoing strength in asset quality measures, together with the anticipated attainment of solid operating results in future periods, should enable us to continue to build shareholder value while providing sufficient capital support for expected asset growth."


**About Mercantile Bank Corporation**


Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Mercantile Bank Corporation is the bank holding company for Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank. Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank provide financial products and services in a professional and personalized manner designed to make banking easier for businesses, individuals, and governmental units. Distinguished by exceptional service, knowledgeable staff, and a commitment to the communities they serve, Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank together comprise one of the largest Michigan-based banking organizations with total combined assets of approximately $7.2 billion. Mercantile Bank Corporation's common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol "MBWM." For more information about Mercantile, visit[www.mercbank.com](http://www.mercbank.com/) , and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter) @MercBank, and LinkedIn @merc-bank.
